name: Shepherd Amos

intro.text: Southdown sheep, these. Small, tough, a face like a teddy bear. They were bred on these hills, and half the world's sheep have a bit of Southdown in them somewhere.

win: Ah, well. The sheep weren't watching.
after: My grandad's grandad kept a shepherd's crook made at Pyecombe forge. Pyecombe hooks were the best in Sussex.
